note: Made-up findings with the shape of a real round: two duplicate pairs, each pair anchored in different files but citing the same line of a third file, and one unrelated finding. All paths and text are invented.

findings.claim: Running the sensor rollout before the shared bucket policy removes the reader's access to the archive
findings.failure_scenario: An operator follows the README order; the archive reader gets 403 until the policy is reapplied.

findings.claim: The rollout order in the stations README revokes the archive reader's grant
findings.failure_scenario: Applying stations first replaces the bucket binding; the reader loses access.

findings.claim: The grant test reads only the reader binding, so a grant made through another resource still passes
findings.failure_scenario: A second binding grants write; the test inspects only the reader binding and passes.

findings.claim: The access test asserts only on bucket_binding.reader
findings.failure_scenario: Write access granted elsewhere is never checked.

findings.claim: The station tag binding is checked by name only
findings.failure_scenario: A binding with the right name but the wrong value passes.
